Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC traffic telemetry & acceptance path

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap + next steps so we have a single source of truth for the POC intake. High-level ask: we need a representative traffic snapshot and owners signed up so Redwood can produce a trial configuration and telemetry dashboard for acceptance testing.

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Primary workload: user-facing summarization for financial docs (customer service transcripts + docs).
- Expected steady-state RPS: 300–500 (peak planning: 1,200 RPS burst windows).
- Typical token length: avg ~42 tokens; 95th percentile ~320 tokens; occasional single-request ~1,200 tokens in larger docs.
- Concurrency: 60 sustained, target test concurrency for canary: 150.
- Burst profile: 10–15 minute bursts up to 1,000–1,200 RPS during business hours; smaller hourly microbursts ~200 RPS.
- Quality bar / acceptance: median generation latency < 180ms; p50 pgen cost within agreed budget; p95 < 450ms for 95% of production-shaped traffic; no functional regression on the sample prompt set.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
1) Traffic ingestion & validation (Ben) — Apr 23–24: Redwood receives representative payloads (CSV + JSONL), we sanity-check tokenization and pathologies.
2) Baseline benchmarking (Priyom) — Apr 25–27: run 48-hour steady-state + 2 synthetic burst windows matching their peaks.
3) Telemetry + acceptance dashboards (Marissa) — Apr 27–29: provide MTTR metrics, latency distributions, cost per 1k tokens, and anomaly detection flags.
4) Acceptance signoff (Finovate + Redwood) — by May 3: agree on success criteria and sign off on rollout.

Immediate asks for Finovate (action items):
- Share a 48–72h sample of production-shaped requests (anonymized) as CSV/JSONL. Include: timestamp, request size (tokens), model call type, and user-agent.
- Flag any PII to be redacted and call out session patterns (long conversational chains vs single-shot doc summarization).
- Confirm a staging endpoint and credentials (or allow our connector to pull sample telemetry).

Attachments: finovate-traffic-sample.csv (stub), poc-timeline.xlsx (POC schedule).

Owners (tentative): Ben Carter (technical intake & customer-facing), Priyom Das (bench/infrastructure), Marissa Cole (POC milestones & acceptance dashboard).

If this matches your understanding, please reply with the sample files and a preferred kickoff window for the benchmarking run (we're proposing Apr 26–27 for the baseline).

Thanks,
Ben

Liam — appreciate the quick turnaround on the sample. Quick requests before we kick off on Apr 26:
1) Please confirm the export includes at least one example of the long-document (>1k tokens) requests so we can validate KV cache and memory behavior.
2) Double-check that timestamps are UTC or include timezone offsets (helps for burst alignment).
3) If possible, include a small file with user-agent variation so we can mirror client multiplexing patterns.

We will treat all files as redacted but please avoid embedding PII in any free-text fields. Once we have the staging creds we will run an ingestion validation by Apr 24 evening and confirm readiness for the Apr 26 run.

Ben
